reply.summary: Valnteco is a tall, soft-spoken courtroom orator who steered a fractured republic through bitter civil strife. He wins crowds with patient talk and, when cornered, with a surprisingly strong grappling hold.

feats.scene: Valnteco hurls a burly rival flat onto a barn floor in front of a cheering crowd.
Valnteco shrugs off a hard tumble from a rickety stage during a heated rally.

reply.summary: Riaiaril is a towering horned warlord who began as a primitive hunter and swelled into a soul-devouring giant. He rules a stone fortress above a conquered chain of worlds and plots to swallow a neighbouring reality.

feats.scene: Riaiaril crushes the crust of a rebellious world with one stamp of his foot.
Riaiaril stands unharmed as a shattering volley from allied armies rakes his chest.

reply.summary: Nuval is a scholarly ape noblewoman whose zeal led her to storm a hidden island of warrior women. Her faith cracked when a glowing cord forced the truth from her lips, and she vanished home in despair.

feats.scene: Nuval smashes through a wooden gate with her shoulder during the siege.
Nuval is bound by a glowing cord and endures the struggle without a mark.

reply.summary: Stlannto is a bruised city dweller who idolised the caped hunter of the night, then accepted a rich patron's gear and strange treatments. Cast aside, he haunts the streets in shadow, hoping the patron will return.

feats.scene: Stlannto drives a steel pipe through a patrol car window in a single blow.
Stlannto takes a heavy beating from armed guards and keeps stalking forward.

reply.summary: Abyssma is a pale-eyed, clawed alien soldier driven by blind fury. A glowing ring fuelled by his own rage lets him lash out at anyone near him.

feats.scene: Abyssma rips a hovering transport apart with a surge of scarlet force.
Abyssma wades through a hail of shells with only singed skin.

reply.summary: Teirsau keeps a rambling hostelry that sits outside every ordinary land, sheltering weary wanderers under strict house law. The place has been wrecked many times, and Teirsau rises again to rebuild each time.

feats.scene: Teirsau raises a whole timber hall from rubble in a single night with a sweep of his hands.
Teirsau is caught inside as hunters flatten the building, then wakes among the ruins.

reply.summary: Ausora is a masked overseer who draws on a cosmic current of motion to run faster than sight. Sparks crackle along the limbs as the figure slips between neighbouring realities.

feats.scene: Ausora hits a parked van at a sprint and folds it around a lamp post.
Ausora crosses a whole district in the time it takes a coin to fall.

reply.summary: Ameon is a runner who channels a boundless current of velocity and was drafted into a gathering of fast heroes from many worlds. Wanted by police for vigilante work, he took up a streaked costume.

feats.scene: Ameon punches through a vault door at full sprint, leaving a long trench behind him.
Ameon outruns a racing jet and circles it twice before it can bank.

reply.summary: Salulin is a covert agent whose wired suit makes him blur past guards. Wearing it for long stretches is addictive and slowly erodes his sense of self.

feats.scene: Salulin slams into a steel locker at a dead run and dents it deeply.
Salulin crosses a crowded plaza before a startled guard finishes turning around.

reply.summary: Orinin ran a ring of paid burglars from a shabby flat, with his wife keeping the books. When he learned a famous flyer's secret, he tried bombs, then blackmail, and was left stranded on a high ledge.

feats.scene: Orinin plants a satchel charge that blasts the doorway off a flat.
Orinin tumbles down a stairwell and gets up cursing.

reply.summary: Cetiu is a winged war hound bred in a fire-pit world and ridden into battle by a masked flyer. He fought in a great prison clash and perished under a nuclear strike.

feats.scene: Cetiu bowls over three armoured guards in a single leaping charge.
Cetiu endures the heat and blast of a sky-lit detonation before being lost to it.

reply.summary: Minteiu is a scruffy rescue dog with a bandana who was abandoned after a misunderstanding. Glowing orange crystal later gave him enormous strength and a hide nothing can scratch, and he now guards a band of fellow animals.

feats.scene: Minteiu heaves a delivery truck over a fence to reach a trapped friend.
Minteiu sits calmly beneath a collapsing bridge span and shakes off the dust.

reply.summary: Amoiunan is a space patrolman whose body was stitched from four different alien types by a quartet of rays. One half crackles, one half is feathered, and the whole lets him fly and lift with prodigious force.

feats.scene: Amoiunan flings a derelict freighter hull aside to open a path for escaping travellers.
Amoiunan walks out of a lab explosion with only a scorched sleeve.

reply.summary: Aniuvos is a green-and-blue patchwork being who sips drinks in a smoky hangout for retired costumed folk. He listens quietly when a famous leader urges everyone to behave like heroes again.

feats.scene: Aniuvos slaps a bar table to demand quiet from the room.
Aniuvos is jostled by a rowdy crowd and does not so much as stumble.

reply.summary: Colnasllu was a cheerful tour pilot whose liner was swept off course by a comet's wake. Stranded in a dead scientist's lab, he was hit by four rays at once and became a patchwork of four alien bodies.

feats.scene: Colnasllu bats a hostile drone into a rocky moonlet and cracks it in half.
Colnasllu lives through a radiation wave that tosses his ship across a solar system.

reply.summary: Lancese is a green-skinned spacefarer who was seized by a giant starfish tyrant. When free, he hurls beams from his hands and soars through the void.

feats.scene: Lancese fires a beam that tears a hole through a drifting asteroid.
Lancese resists the squeeze of a mind-capturing parasite long enough to shout a warning.

reply.summary: Naute was a wealthy pilot who met a dying visitor from beyond the sky in 1940. The visitor passed him a glowing belt and warned of an invasion, and Naute took to the air as a masked defender.

feats.scene: Naute shatters a raider's alien cannon with a belt-powered blast.
Naute survives a crash landing in a ploughed field with a few bruises.

reply.summary: Testlen was a wartime flyer drafted into a disposable black-ops squad. His one known job sent him into a frozen wartime hot spot abroad.

feats.scene: Testlen drops a crate of grenades onto an enemy trench from a low pass.
Testlen climbs out of a crashed biplane with a limp and a grin.

reply.summary: Lenumrni is a hulking card-themed robber who crushes locks and cash boxes with bare hands. He answers to a gaudy gang that decorates every heist with playing-card flair.

feats.scene: Lenumrni folds a bank's steel shutter in half and tosses it aside.
Lenumrni plows through a police barricade and keeps charging.

reply.summary: Serlliile commanded a squad of costumed thieves and zipped about on a flat board shaped like a playing card. A sudden lightning storm ended his bounty run and freed his prisoners.

feats.scene: Serlliile rams his hovering board into a captive's cell door and bends it.
Serlliile endures a battering fall from his board before the final strike.

reply.summary: Osataslan is a bald, white-eyed machine in a thief's costume, built to crack safes and brawl. His metal frame lifts vehicles and ignores bullets.

feats.scene: Osataslan lifts a sports car overhead and drops it on a pursuing patrol.
Osataslan stands in a storm of cannon rounds that merely chip his casing.

reply.summary: Rnsil is a masked crook who leads a card-themed gang in modern times. Two teenage heroes had little trouble putting a stop to his schemes.

feats.scene: Rnsil swings a pistol butt at a guard and flattens him.
Rnsil is thrown across a rooftop and gets up dazed.

reply.summary: Raterco is a hardened career thief who fronts a theatrical gang of card-costumed raiders. He prefers smash-and-grab jobs planned down to the minute.

feats.scene: Raterco bashes open a display case with a gloved fist.
Raterco shakes off a hard tackle from a night guard.

reply.summary: Rnilule is a dark-haired woman who leads a costumed gang of burglars with a card motif. She keeps her true identity hidden behind a flashy mask.

feats.scene: Rnilule kicks a jewellery counter's glass in with a sharp heel.
Rnilule rolls off a moving van unhurt.

reply.summary: Locorntu is a brown-haired thief who tried to rob a casino strip with his masked gang, only to be thwarted by a stage magician. He treats crime as showmanship.

feats.scene: Locorntu cracks a slot machine's case with a crowbar swing.
Locorntu is spun around by a conjured gust and stays upright.

reply.summary: Anulamo is a mechanical hound with light-sensing eyes and a jaw that chews through metal. Rewired by new owners, it fires cables to swing over rooftops and sprints faster than a motorbike.

feats.scene: Anulamo bites a steel girder in two to free a trapped ally.
Anulamo bolts down an alley faster than a speeding motorbike.

reply.summary: Stinuia is a big mixed-breed dog who fled a cruel fighting ring and found a lonely old man on a bleak street. Fiercely loyal, he later helped sabotage a villain's orbiting weapon.

feats.scene: Stinuia leaps and knocks a thug off his feet with a bite to the sleeve.
Stinuia shakes off a hard kick from an angry gang boss.

reply.summary: Ninsti is a black-furred, white-eyed hound who keeps an ageing millionaire company in a futuristic metropolis. He is a faithful pet who sniffs out trouble before anyone else.

feats.scene: Ninsti tugs a trouser leg hard enough to pull a thief off balance.
Ninsti is kicked aside and bounces straight back up.

reply.summary: Celorlia is a line of guard dogs kept by a caped crime fighter across many decades: a shepherd, a mastiff and an elderly companion. Each has fangs, claws and a nose for tracking.

feats.scene: Celorlia pins a fleeing burglar to the pavement by the shoulder.
Celorlia survives a fall from a cave ledge and trots on.

reply.summary: Tante is a grey-muzzled canine detective trained in fighting, gadgets and keen sniffing. He teams up with a cartoon sleuth pack to solve odd cases.

feats.scene: Tante flips a masked suspect over his hip with a trained throw.
Tante takes a stumble through a haunted staircase without a whimper.

reply.summary: Nussauan is a brown-coated hound who tracks by scent and fights with teeth and claws. He once fought off a jungle cat to protect his master and was rewarded with a biscuit.

feats.scene: Nussauan lunges at a striped predator and drives it from his master.
Nussauan is raked by the cat and shrugs it off.

reply.summary: Anite is a swindler who persuaded a whole city he was the heir to an invincible old warrior. A concealed generator in a boot repelled blades and bullets, but a hero saw through the trick and handed him to police.

feats.scene: Anite swings a cudgel at a bank clerk's counter and cracks the wood.
Anite stands unharmed as a volley of bullets is flung wide by his boot's field.

reply.summary: Llirnva is a sea-nymph's son bathed in a legendary river to be proof against harm, save for one ankle. He fights through a ten-year siege and now serves as a spirit guide to a young champion.

feats.scene: Llirnva smashes through a bronze gate and routs the defenders behind it.
Llirnva wades through a storm of spears and arrows without a scratch.

reply.summary: Ntieru is among the first mortals, a quiet woman who fled a forced match and later wed the man she once avoided. She lives for ages in a dreamlike house with her husband, caring for a lonely sibling.

feats.scene: Ntieru slaps a bowl of fruit out of an intruder's hands.
Ntieru endures the passing of centuries in a single unbroken thread of life.

reply.summary: Rnicil is a mere man painted blue with fake horns who longs to unseat the heavens and install a new god. His wild scheme involved a cartoon broadcast meant to turn children against their parents.

feats.scene: Rnicil shoves an acolyte off a pulpit step during a rant.
Rnicil is tackled by teenage heroes and shakes it off.

reply.summary: Niami is a travelling circus tumbler afflicted by a strange malady that turns him vicious under a full moon. A young hero repeatedly stopped his violent rampages.

feats.scene: Niami vaults from a trapeze and kicks a ringmaster across the sawdust.
Niami drops from a high wire onto a net and bounds back up.

reply.summary: Centoia is a white-skinned, black-eyed sorceress from a northern land who guards a bubbling vessel full of occult secrets. A rival borrowed it to settle an old debt, drawing her into a team of night-time magicians.

feats.scene: Centoia hurls a blast of spell-fire that melts a cobbled lane.
Centoia steps through a hex-storm that fells her enemies.

reply.summary: Arlesan is a blond artificial man grown from borrowed cells in a secret lab. He seized the facility, bred a clone army wired to a giant brain, and was undone when his own sonic weapon was turned against that brain.

feats.scene: Arlesan unleashes a sonic pulse that cripples a hallway of rivals and cracks the concrete.
Arlesan shrugs off a blow that would fell a grown man.

reply.summary: Reoce is a talking chimpanzee in dark sunglasses who joins a team of unusual operatives. He speaks in clipped, cheery lines and loves a good joke.

feats.scene: Reoce swings from a rope and clobbers a thug with his fists.
Reoce tumbles down a flight of stairs and laughs it off.

reply.summary: Aucolco is the first man, shaped by the creator and given the task of naming every beast in a lush orchard. One creature refused a name and has hounded his descendants ever since, so his dreams spawned a guardian hound.

feats.scene: Aucolco calls out a name and a wild animal settles at his feet.
Aucolco walks out of paradise's gates unharmed by the flaming guard.

reply.summary: Vorileeo performs blade dances in a dim nightclub and lent a hand to two travellers hunting a lost chart. He later turned on them for a pale-robed patron and paid with his life.

feats.scene: Vorileeo whirls two sabres and slices through a hanging chandelier chain.
Vorileeo takes a hard slap from a bouncer and keeps dancing.

reply.summary: Lleeoto is a man born with a body far ahead of his era, barely ageing after long journeys through space. He became a prison keeper for rogue humans and was finally killed in their uprising.

feats.scene: Lleeoto punches a snarling prisoner to the ground in one blow.
Lleeoto absorbs a flurry of blows from several inmates without flinching.

reply.summary: Amres was a young man who hurled himself at a rampaging monster twice, only to be knocked down. He is destined to become a hero of the next generation.

feats.scene: Amres rockets skyward and slams into a giant foe with all his might.
Amres is hurled to the ground and gets up with a limp.

reply.summary: Lortor is a crop-duster pilot who lost his family to an invasion and formed a corps of displaced aviators. A genetic procedure keeps him youthful, and he fathered a son he never knew about.

feats.scene: Lortor dives his old biplane through a convoy and scatters it.
Lortor walks away from a crash in a rice paddy.

reply.summary: Rnteslan is one of three hellborn heirs raised to ruin the man who sired them. He bends minds, calls up horrors and moves objects by will alone.

feats.scene: Rnteslan collapses a chapel's roof with a thought and a whispered rite.
Rnteslan shrugs off a barrage of holy fire while chanting.

reply.summary: Sesticor is a red-haired government operative recruited to impersonate a shrinking hero. He joined a deadly black-ops team, saved a wounded boss from hit men, and was eventually run through by a rival.

feats.scene: Sesticor takes down two assassins with quick strikes in a stairwell.
Sesticor sustains a heavy beating before the final blade.

reply.summary: Stontora is a blond cartoon child scientist who lives in a playful kids' city. When classmates were accidentally shrunk by baby milk, he fetched an uncle who could resize them.

feats.scene: Stontora tosses a foam ball across a classroom.
Stontora tumbles off a sofa and bounces like a rubber toy.

reply.summary: Eonse is a former soldier with a long grudge who sold out his oldest friend's unit. Twelve died in the ambush he set, and he has lived underground ever since.

feats.scene: Eonse triggers a roadside charge that wrecks an armoured jeep.
Eonse takes a rifle-butt to the jaw and keeps running.

reply.summary: Vetalse is a stretchy musician who first wanted revenge on a record boss and later reformed to help a teenage hero. He once spoke directly to the audience about a learning difference.

feats.scene: Vetalse stretches his arm across a stage and slaps a guitar from a rival's hands.
Vetalse bounces off a brick wall like a rubber ball.

reply.summary: Numne is a hired killer who presses a palm to the ground and sends tremors through it, finely tuning how hard they hit. He once raided a village for pay and later sat frozen in a rival's stasis chamber.

feats.scene: Numne cracks a village's main street open with a slow, grinding quake.
Numne takes a brutal punch and sets his stance again.
